cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved your taxi plan. You may dry this last cup before it arrives.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. It's here. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Departure is approved once the cup is on its shelf. I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling now; may I leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may put him on speaker first. I'll thank him for waiting before I release you. What is his name?

reason: Remove an unclear relationship between the driver name and approving departure. The name is now explicitly needed for the courtesy conversation that delays release.
